NAME-KEYED CROSS-REFERENCE HAZARD (highest-risk item in the project): creature actors link to their attack tables BY TABLE NAME, not by id — actor field system.rTables holds literal strings like 'EV - Chestburster Attacks' (4 actors), 'EV - Praetorian, Charger and Queen Attacks' (3), 'EV - Stalker, Scout and Drone Attacks' (3), 'EV - Neomorph Attacks' (2), 'EV - Facehugger Attacks' (2), 'EV - Harvester Attacks' (2), 'EV - Soldier and Sentry Attacks' (2), 'Critical Injuries on Xenomorphs' (1), 'EV - Lion Worm Attacks' (1), 'EV - Neomorphic Bloodburster Attacks' (1); system.cTables holds 25 more. 26 actors hold the literal string 'None'. If a RollTable name is translated but the actor's rTables string is not (or vice versa), the creature's attack roll silently breaks. Either translate both sides in lockstep or leave RollTable NAMES in English. The 4 system macros ('Roll on selected Mother table V10', 'Roll on selected Creature table V10', 7865 chars of JS) and the corerules macro 'Roll on Danger Event Detail Table' also reference table names from code — inspect before renaming anything.

SCENES: 15 scenes total, only 2 carry translatable text — starterset 'Hadley's Hope - Level 1' (20 notes) and 'Hadley's Hope - Level 2' (17 notes), 349 chars of room labels. All 8 corerules scenes and the other 5 starterset scenes have zero notes and zero drawing text; only their names are translatable. The 37 note labels are the same strings as the 17 Map Pins page names and the Hope's Last Day h3 location headings — one owner, byte-identical output, or the pins mismatch the text.

IMAGE-ONLY JOURNAL PAGES: 92 pages carry no text at all — 'Core Rules - Art of Alien' (74 pages) and 'The Art of Alien' (18 pages). Their image.caption fields are empty, so only the 92 page NAMES are translatable (part of the CR-UI / SS-UI units). This is why corerules has 112 pages but only 38 text pages, and starterset 38 pages but only 20 text pages.

BABELE PACKAGING: Babele 2.9.1 is installed at <data>/modules/babele and already ships Adventure defaultMappings, so all three packs can be shipped as Adventure-type translation files without a custom mapping. Note the nested-document requirement: Adventure translations must carry sub-maps for journal.pages, tables.results, actors.items (embedded), plus folders and scenes.notes. Two source strings contain non-breaking spaces that will break naive key matching: the journal entry name 'CORE RULES\xa0-\xa0HOW\xa0TO\xa0USE\xa0THIS\xa0MODULE' (U+00A0 throughout, while its page name uses normal spaces) and the page name '11. CAMPAIGN  PLAY' (double space). The macro name 'Alien -  GM Dice Roller' also has a double space.

PARALLELISATION SHAPE: 96 units. 5 anchor units (~118k chars) must finish first. After that, 3 dependency chains constrain ordering — (core rules ch.2/3/4) → Starter Set Rules ×4; (Hope's Last Day ×2) → Map Pins; (ch.12/ch.13) → the two crib sheets; plus CR-T-CORERES → SS-T-CORERES + SYS-T-CORERES, and CR-A-CRE-1 → CR-A-CRE-2/3 + SS-A-CRE.
